title: 美银Winnie：英伟达比中国AI还便宜？明年中国能否跑赢
speaker: Winnie

segments.en: One thing I didn't expect, and I think most people didn't see the Nvidia story coming this year, was Nvidia is actually now cheaper than China when you look at it in a PE basis.
segments.zh: 有一件事我没料到，而且我认为大多数人今年也没预见到英伟达的故事，那就是按市盈率来看，英伟达现在实际上比中国还便宜。

segments.en: On that note, do you think China can outperform next year?
segments.zh: 说到这个，你认为明年中国能跑赢吗？

segments.en: I mean, you know, again, it's all relative, and it's also depending on the timing of China, or if there's any Chinese policy response, right?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，这又是相对的，也取决于中国的时机，或者是否有任何中国政策回应，对吧？

segments.en: Potentially, past a few years, export has hold up China's economic growth and data everything.
segments.zh: 有可能，过去几年，出口支撑了中国的经济增长和数据等。

segments.en: If next year we're facing a broader challenges globally, export is slowing down, then maybe policymakers will do something to stimulate.
segments.zh: 如果明年我们面临更广泛的全球挑战，出口放缓，那么也许政策制定者会采取一些刺激措施。

segments.en: And in that case, in the full year basis, next year, China could outperform.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，按全年基础计算，明年中国可能跑赢。
